source_text: Περὶ τοῦ τοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς αἱρέσεως τῶν λεγομένων Φρυγῶν ἐπιστρέφοντας, εἰ καὶ ἐν κλήρῳ νομιζομένῳ παρ᾽ αὐτοῖς τυγχάνοιεν, εἰ καὶ μέγιστοι λέγοιντο, τοὺς τοιούτους μετὰ πάσης ἐπιμελείας κατηχεῖσθαί τε καὶ βαπτίζεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐπισκόπων τε καὶ πρεσβυτέρων. Ἐ ρ μ η ν ε ί α. Καὶ οὗτος ὁ Κανὼν σύμφωνος εἶναι μὲ τὸ ζ΄. τῆς β΄. Διορίζει γάρ, ὡς καὶ ἐκεῖνος, ὅτι οἱ καλούμενοι Φρύγες, ἤτοι οἱ Μοντανισταί, ὅταν ἐπιστρέφουν πρὸς τὴν ὀρθοδοξίαν, πρέπει ὡς Ἕλληνες νά κατηχοῦνται καὶ νά βαπτίζωνται ἀπὸ τοὺς Ἐπισκόπους καὶ Πρεσβυτέρους μετὰ ἐξετάσεως καὶ ἐπιμελείας, κἀν καὶ αὐτοὶ ὀνομάζωνται μέγιστοι, ὡς διδάσκαλοι καὶ ὑπερέχοντες τῶν ἄλλων, κἀν καὶ ἦναι ἀπὸ τοὺς παρ’ αὐτοῖς νομιζομένους μέν, μὴ ὄντας δὲ ἀληθῶς Κληρικούς. Ἀνάγνωθι καὶ τὸν μς΄. καὶ μζ΄. Ἀποστολικόν. Καὶ μάλιστα τὸν ζ΄. τῆς β΄.
thought_title: Reception of returning Phrygians requires catechesis and baptism
orientation: The council continues its rulings on how heretics returning to orthodoxy are to be received, now addressing the Phrygians (Montanists).
pass_a_gloss: Concerning those returning from the heresy of the so-called Phrygians, even if they should happen to be in a clergy deemed such among them, even if they should be called greatest, such persons are with all care to be catechized and baptized by the bishops and presbyters of the church. Interpretation. And this Canon is in agreement with the 7th of the 2nd. For it determines, as also that one, that those called Phrygians, that is the Montanists, whenever they return to orthodoxy, must as Greeks be catechized and be baptized by the Bishops and Presbyters with examination and care, even if they themselves are named greatest, as teachers and surpassing the others, even if they are from those deemed among them, but not truly being, Clerics. Read also the 46th and 47th Apostolic. And especially the 7th of the 2nd.

choices.why: The source uses λεγομένων to mark the name as a label, not an ethnic identity; 'so-called' preserves that distancing.

choices.english: in a clergy deemed such among them
choices.why: νομιζομένῳ means 'deemed' or 'reckoned', implying the clergy status is only their own estimation, not real; 'deemed such among them' keeps that nuance.
rejected: in a clergy considered by them

choices.why: The superlative is emphatic and ironic in context; 'greatest' preserves the literal force.
The interpretation uses 'Greeks' in the sense of pagans/unbaptized; keeping 'Greeks' is literal and the sense is clear from context.
The interpretation adds ἐξετάσεως to the canon's ἐπιμελείας; both nouns are rendered literally.
The word order and the emphatic ἀληθῶς are preserved to show the contrast between their claimed and real status.

pass_b_english: Concerning those returning from the heresy of the so-called Phrygians: even if they happen to be in a clergy deemed such among them, even if they are called the greatest, such persons are to be catechized and baptized with all care by the bishops and presbyters of the church.

This canon also agrees with canon 7 of the Second Council. For it decrees, as that one does, that the so-called Phrygians, that is, the Montanists, when they return to orthodoxy, must be catechized and baptized as Greeks by the bishops and presbyters, with examination and care—even if they themselves are called the greatest, as teachers and those surpassing the others, and even if they are from those deemed among them, but not truly being, clerics. Read also Apostolic Canons 46 and 47, and especially canon 7 of the Second Council.

last_rejected.why: Misreads ὡς Ἕλληνες: source says 'as Greeks' meaning pagans/heathens, but English 'as Greeks' is ambiguous; however, this is actually correct. Re-checking: the issue is 'with examination and care'—source has 'μετὰ ἐξετάσεως καὶ ἐπιμελείας' but main canon has 'μετὰ πάσης ἐπιμελείας'. The interpretation adds 'examination' not in the canon proper.
last_rejected.fix: with all care, and with examination
last_rejected.ruling: Source commentary has μετὰ ἐξετάσεως καὶ ἐπιμελείας; English correctly translates that phrase. No error.
